newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil firms in line with futures gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil firms in line with futures gains.

text.p: NWE gas oil strengthened on Friday in line with moderate gains in benchmark IPE gas oil futures and slightly firmer premiums, traders said.
July IPE gas oil was trading $1.25 higher at $163.00 a tonne at 1133 GMT.
Heating oil barges traded at July IPE +25 cents fob ARA for first half July delivery and were talked around the July IPE -25 cents/+50 cents fob ARA.
"It's a typically quiet Friday," one trader said.
Diesel premiums were little changed at July IPE +$4.50/+$5.0 fob ARA.
On the cargo front premiums were broadly steady.
EN590 material was talked at around July IPE +$5.50/+$6.50 cif NWE, with Algerian material pegged some 50 cents above there.
Traders said EN590 supply remained healthy but they expected fewer Mediterranean cargoes to move north in July which might help firm premiums slightly.

The O.2 percent market offered a broad range of premiums. Russian material was offered at July IPE +25 cents cif NWE while other 0.2 percent material was offered around July IPE +$1.0-$1.50 cif NWE. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
